I read all 380 commits and 127 merged PRs. Roughly 340 were dependency bumps, tests, CI and refactors that nobody installing this would feel. I drafted the 4.2.0 section into `CHANGELOG.md`.

Three things are breaking, and none were labeled as such:

| Change | Hidden under |
|---|---|
| `v1` export route removed | `refactor(api): drop the unused v1 export route` |
| Expired token returns 401, was 403 | `fix(auth): ...` |
| Internal error types no longer re-exported | 7 `refactor(...)` commits |

Two things to check before you cut. Nine perf commits exist but none are measured, so I left them out. Five commits say "note the minimum node version" but only touch docs, and `package.json` engines never changed.
